cells.value: Any individual, company, or organization employed by the Company through direct contract, purchase order, or agreement that that is engaged in the work described in this specification.
Oil Search Alaska, LLC or its designated representative.
An inspector, Supplier, manufacturer, or inspection agency contracted by the Company to represent the Company.
Any individual, company, or organization that supplies parts, equipment, or material for the work described in this specification.

The term "lot" applies to all items which are produced from the same heat of steel and subjected to the same finishing (i.e., heat treatment, amount of working, and welding procedure), and are of like type, nominal size and wall thickness as defined by the appropriate ASTM specification.
The term "item" shall refer to pipe, fittings, flanges, slip blinds, spacers, and connectors, collectively.
The term "flange" shall mean flanges designed to ASME B16.5 or B16.47 or MSS SP-44, or API 6A Type 6B, or special requirements (for flanges beyond the referenced ratings).

The terms "slip blind" and "spacer" shall mean blinds or spacers intended to be installed between flanges and rest entirely within the flange bolt circle.
